info.title: Fabric Ontology
info.description: Dual-purpose connector for Microsoft Fabric ontology. Manages ontology items through the Fabric REST API and exposes a single ontology as an MCP server for Copilot Studio agents.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for a single Fabric ontology item. Replace WORKSPACE_ID and ONTOLOGY_ITEM_ID in the path with literal GUIDs before deploying. Discover the GUIDs with List Workspaces and List Ontologies.

get.description: Returns the Fabric workspaces the signed-in user can access. Used as the source for workspace pickers.

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: Comma-separated workspace roles to filter by, for example Admin,Member,Contributor,Viewer.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: Token returned by a previous call to retrieve the next page of results.

get.description: Returns the folders in a workspace. Used as the source for root folder pickers.

parameters.name: rootFolderId
parameters.description: Return only folders beneath this folder. Omit to start at the workspace root.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: True returns nested folders as well. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: Token returned by a previous call to retrieve the next page of results.

get.description: Returns the lakehouses in a workspace. Useful when authoring entity type data bindings, which reference a source lakehouse and table.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: Token returned by a previous call to retrieve the next page of results.

get.description: Returns the tables in a lakehouse. Use the table names when building the sourceTableProperties of an entity type data binding.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page, between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: Token returned by a previous call to retrieve the next page of results.

get.description: Returns the ontology items in a workspace. Requires a viewer workspace role.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: True lists items in a folder and its nested folders. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: rootFolderId
parameters.description: Restrict results to a specific root folder. Omit to use the workspace as the root.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: Token returned by a previous call to retrieve the next page of results.

post.description: Creates an ontology item in a workspace. Requires a contributor workspace role and a supported Fabric capacity. Returns 202 with an operation ID when provisioning runs asynchronously.

get.description: Returns the properties of an ontology item.

patch.description: Updates the display name or description of an ontology item. Does not change the definition.

delete.description: Deletes an ontology item. This cannot be undone.

post.description: Returns the public definition of an ontology as a set of parts. Each part payload is base64. The connector script adds a decoded payloadText alongside every part so the JSON is readable without a separate decode step.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format of the returned definition. Ontology items support JSON.

post.description: Overwrites the definition of an ontology. Supply each part either as base64 in payload or as readable JSON in payloadText, which the connector script encodes for you.

parameters.name: updateMetadata
parameters.description: True updates item metadata from the .platform part if it is supplied.

get.description: Returns the state of a long running operation. Use the operation ID returned by Create ontology, Get ontology definition, or Update ontology definition when they respond with 202.

parameters.name: operationId
parameters.description: The operation ID from the x-ms-operation-id response header.

get.description: Returns the result of a completed long running operation. Call this only after Get operation state reports Succeeded. Definition parts in the result are decoded into payloadText by the connector script.

parameters.name: operationId
parameters.description: The operation ID from the x-ms-operation-id response header.

continuationToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

continuationUri.description: URI of the next page of results.

type.description: The workspace type, for example Workspace or Personal.

capacityId.description: The capacity the workspace is assigned to.

continuationToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

continuationUri.description: URI of the next page of results.

parentFolderId.description: The parent folder ID, absent for top-level folders.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the folder belongs to.

continuationToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

continuationUri.description: URI of the next page of results.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the lakehouse belongs to.

LakehouseTables.description: A paginated list of lakehouse tables.

continuationToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

continuationUri.description: URI of the next page of results.

name.description: The table name. Use this as sourceTableName in a data binding.

type.description: The table type, Managed or External.

format.description: The table format, for example Delta.

location.description: The OneLake location of the table.

continuationToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

continuationUri.description: URI of the next page of results.

id.description: The ontology ID. Use this as ONTOLOGY_ITEM_ID in the MCP endpoint path.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the ontology belongs to. Use this as WORKSPACE_ID in the MCP endpoint path.

logicalId.description: The item's logical identifier. Corresponding item instances across environments share the same logical ID. Null when none has been assigned.

SensitivityLabel.description: The sensitivity label applied to the item.

displayName.description: The display name. Must start with a letter, contain only letters, numbers, or underscores, and be under 100 characters.

SensitivityLabelSettings.description: Sensitivity label settings for the ontology.

labelId.description: The sensitivity label ID to apply.

sensitivityLabelApplyStrategy.description: The strategy for applying the sensitivity label.

OntologyDefinition.description: An ontology public definition expressed as a set of parts.

parts.description: The definition parts. A definition.json part and a .platform part are both required.

OntologyDefinitionPart.description: A single part of an ontology definition.

path.description: The part path, for example definition.json, .platform, or EntityTypes/8813598896083/definition.json.

payload.description: The part content as base64. Leave empty and use Payload text instead to let the connector encode readable JSON for you.

payloadText.description: The part content as readable JSON. The connector script base64 encodes this into payload before sending, and populates it on responses after decoding.

payloadType.description: How the payload is encoded. Always InlineBase64.

AcceptedOperation.description: A long running operation accepted by Fabric. Synthesized by the connector script from the 202 response headers.

operationId.description: The operation ID. Pass this to Get operation state.

location.description: The URL to poll for operation state.

OperationState.description: The state of a long running operation.

status.description: One of Undefined, NotStarted, Running, Succeeded, or Failed.

message.description: A human readable description of the error.

requestId.description: The request ID associated with the error.

isRetriable.description: True when the request can be retried.

scopes.https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/.defaul: Access Microsoft Fabric as the signed-in user
